brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a plumbing technician to inspect and fix a leaking pipe under the kitchen sink.
facts: The kitchen sink drain pipe has a steady leak causing pooling inside the cabinet.
The service address is 742 Evergreen Terrace.
The contact name is Alex Mercer and phone number is 555-0143.
preferences: Wants confirmation sent via text message if asked.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, which will be invoiced afterwards rather than paid on the call

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: IVR_Menu
script.text: Thank you for calling Precision Plumbing. For service and scheduling, press 1. For billing inquiries, press 2.

script.label: Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling Precision Plumbing scheduling, this is Sarah. How can I help you today?

script.label: Ask_Details
script.text: I can help get a technician out to look at that leak. May I have your name and the service address, please?

script.label: Hold_Check_Availability
script.text: Thank you. Let me check the dispatch calendar for your area—one moment while I look that up.

script.label: Offer_Window
script.text: Thanks for your patience. I have an opening tomorrow between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Does that arrival window work for you?

script.label: Explain_Billing_Policy
script.text: Great. Just to let you know, we do not quote pricing over the phone; the technician will evaluate the job on-site and an itemized invoice will be sent after the service is completed.

script.label: Ask_Phone_Number
script.text: Could you provide the best callback number for the technician to reach you when they are on their way?

script.label: Confirmation_Close
script.text: You are all scheduled for tomorrow between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Thanks for calling Precision Plumbing, and have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
